stories.title: Connah’s Quay swimmer Rhys Darbey wins Commonwealth Games bronze in Glasgow
stories.summary: Connah’s Quay swimmer Rhys Darbey has won a Commonwealth Games bronze medal in Glasgow after the team-mate who beat him to third place was disqualified. stories.title: Amazon donates 30 emergency bags for people fleeing domestic abuse in north Wales
stories.summary: Thirty emergency bags for people fleeing domestic abuse are to be held at police stations across north Wales, after a donation from Amazon to North Wales Police. stories.summary: Great crested newts will be fenced out of land on the A55 at Ewloe before work starts on an electric vehicle charging station, under plans lodged with Flintshire County Council. stories.title: Have you seen Kelly? Police searching for 36-year-old missing from Holywell
stories.summary: North Wales Police have appealed for help to find a woman missing from Holywell. The force said officers have concerns for Kelly, 36, and that she may have travelled to Towyn and the surrounding area. stories.title: Mold: First look at new joint archive for Flintshire and Denbighshire
stories.summary: Plans have revealed how Flintshire’s proposed new £13 million record office and archive will look if approved.
